t: This Mapei Mapesil AC 110 silicone sealant is a high-performance, solvent-free solution for robust sealing tasks. It is ideal for professional tradesmen working on sanitaryware, wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays in domestic and commercial properties. Providing reliable protection in both interior and exterior environments, it is waterproof and highly resistant to mould and mildew growth, ensuring a lasting finish. The sealant withstands temperatures up to 180°C and offers chemical resistance for demanding conditions. This Manhattan Grey sealant coordinates seamlessly with the Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout range.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
